When did online casinos launch in Ontario?
+
The legal, commercialized market of online casinos in Ontario launched on April 4, 2022.
How many online casinos are live in Ontario?
+
As of November 2026, 70 licensed gaming sites are live, run by 49 registered operators. Most of those carry casino games, 70 by our count of the iGO directory, and the rest are sportsbook, poker or bingo only. One operator can run several sites, which is why the site count runs so far ahead of the operator count.
